configuration.title: DB Client
config.dbclient.maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows fetched per statement. Larger result sets are truncated.
config.dbclient.pageSize.description: Rows per page in the results grid.
config.dbclient.codeLens.description: Show a Run action above each statement in SQL editors bound to a connection.
config.dbclient.sqlFolder.description: Folder where each SQL connection keeps its saved .sql files (one subfolder per connection). Empty uses the extension's global storage; point it at a synced or versioned folder to share the files.
config.dbclient.historySize.description: Statements and Redis commands kept in each connection's query history (Query History…). 0 turns the history off. AUTH, HELLO, ACL, MIGRATE and CONFIG commands are never recorded.
extension.description: Database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, SQLite, Redis and NATS.
